Chapter titles come from the book's table of contents. topics[] = the numbered first-level section headings found in the body text (lines starting 'N.M ' or 'N.M. ' with the chapter's number N), machine-collected; the exercise headings 'Reflect and Discuss' / 'Check Your Understanding' are skipped and sub-sections (N.M.K) are not listed.
